name: Katt Williams
bio: Micah S. Katt Williams (born September 2, 1971) is an American comedian, rapper, and actor. He is best known for his role as Money Mike in Friday After Next, and is also known as his stint on Nick Cannon’s MTV improv show, Wild 'n Out and for playing the Bobby Shaw on the TV series My Wife and Kids.
